items.title: Reindeer Pulling a Gift Sled
items.alt: Dark-brown cartoon reindeer in a green chest harness pulling a small wooden sled loaded with red and green presents.
items.description: Two green traces connect the harness to the sled's curved runners. A thick cream neck ruff, long face and wide branching antlers distinguish the walking animal.

items.title: Reindeer Holding a Cocoa Mug
items.alt: Round golden-brown cartoon reindeer seated with a red cocoa mug between its forehooves and a blue neckerchief.
items.description: Cream marshmallows rise above the snowflake-patterned mug. Large green eyes, short antler forks and two forward-facing rear hooves give the little animal a cozy seated silhouette.

items.title: Reindeer Balancing on Ice Skates
items.alt: Blue-eyed cartoon reindeer in a green knitted beanie balancing on two silver-bladed skates with forelegs stretched outward.
items.description: One rear leg lifts behind the reindeer while the other skate supports the pose. A cream chest and wide antler crown contrast with its slim cinnamon-brown body.

items.title: Reindeer Delivering a Christmas Letter
items.alt: Brown cartoon reindeer walking with a cream envelope held in its mouth and a red mail satchel over its shoulder.
items.description: A buckled strap crosses the reindeer's cream chest above the forward-stepping hoof. The blank envelope and red satchel create a simple festive delivery scene.

items.title: Reindeer Looking at a Lantern
items.alt: Small brown cartoon reindeer in a burgundy knitted neck warmer looking down at a glowing brass lantern beside its front hooves.
items.description: The reindeer tilts its round face toward the lantern's warm light. Short antlers, a pale chest and a few small white back markings distinguish the standing animal.

items.title: Reindeer with Hanging Christmas Baubles
items.alt: Green-eyed brown cartoon reindeer lifting one rear hoof, with three red and gold baubles hanging from its antlers.
items.description: The ornaments hang from separate antler branches above a slim, side-stepping body. A long cream throat patch and raised short tail add to the flowing silhouette.
